shared_elements: relief carving of figures on stone surface
justification: Both surfaces carry relief carving that includes human-like figures and circular disc motifs, and both have banded horizontal elements framing or crossing the design, but these are generic. A depicts a single massive, schematic, frontal figure-like block with abstract incised symbols (concentric circle, chevrons), while B depicts a naturalistic profile procession scene of a led two-humped camel with attendants holding staffs between rosette borders, with no shared narrative or relationships.
